answer: Deposits are visible in vault, and pearl reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 49% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 86 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jetty account. The attacker spends 246 dollars and 8 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
